description: This file defines the UpdateSettingsForm class for configuring update settings in a Drupal site, including form building, validation, and submission handling.

classes.name: UpdateSettingsForm
classes.description: A form class for configuring update-related settings in Drupal.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: getEditableConfigNames
methods.description: Returns the list of configuration names that can be edited by this form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the update settings form with various configuration options.

methods.name: formatMultipleViolationsMessage
methods.description: Formats validation messages for email address violations.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission and updates configuration, clearing update storage if necessary.

methods.name: multiLineStringToArray
methods.description: Converts a multiline string into an array of trimmed email addresses.

methods.name: arrayToMultiLineString
methods.description: Converts an array of email addresses into a multiline string.
